summary_ja: スロッティング・クライテリアは、特定貸付債権の区分(プロジェクト・ファイナンス等)ごとに利用することを定める。
summary_en: Requires the slotting criteria to be used separately for each category of specialized lending: project finance, object finance, commodity finance and commercial real estate lending.
paragraphs: In using the slotting criteria under Article 129, paragraphs (4) and (6), an Ultimate Designated Parent Company adopting the internal ratings-based approach shall use them separately for each category of project finance, object finance, commodity finance and commercial real estate lending.
